column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying the facility (e.g., 'FAC001').
An enum (referralsource_enum) for how the patient was referred (Self, Court, Physician, Emergency, Family).
An enum (environmentalstressors_enum) describing stressors in the environment (Mild, Moderate, Severe).
An enum (lifeeventsimpact_enum) showing how life events impact the patient (Mild, Moderate, Severe).
An enum (seasonalpattern_enum) capturing any seasonal pattern in symptoms (Summer, Winter, Variable).
An enum (legalissues_enum) describing the patient's legal issues (Resolved, Pending, Ongoing).
An enum (supportsystemchanges_enum) describing changes in support system (Variable, Improved, Declined).
